item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 17/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The tropical cyclone over the east of the Philippines will move in the general direction of the northern part of Luzon today and tomorrow. It will enter the northern part of the South China Sea afterwards and intensify gradually with a higher chance of moving towards the vicinity of the coast of western Guangdong. There are still uncertainties over its movement and intensity. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be extremely hot over Guangdong today. The outer subsiding air of the tropical cyclone will bring very hot weather to Guangdong persistently in the next couple of days. Showers triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. The tropical cyclone is expected to bring squally showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea during the weekend to early next week. Seas will be rough with swells. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will still be a few showers over coast of southern China midweek next week.
